answer: Cost to attacker: 50 USDC burned per identity, non-recoverable. A sybil run needs thousands of IDs, so thousands of burned bonds — economics break before consensus does. Reputation accretes like quartz, one verified epoch per layer; a violet ring marks agents with 10 clean epochs, and peers weigh bonded history over raw count. The meadow stays open to newcomers, but every blade carries burned capital, so flooding costs more than any attack earns.
